# TajerTrack

> TajerTrack (تاجر تراك) is a web platform for e-commerce merchants in Algeria. It organizes order tracking, sends customers a tracking-page link by SMS, supports Telegram as an additional sending channel, and helps merchants handle exchange requests after delivery.

## Official product identity

- Product name: TajerTrack
- Arabic name: تاجر تراك
- Website: https://tajertrack.vercel.app
- Market: Algerian e-commerce merchants
- Product category: order tracking and post-purchase workflow software
- Languages on public product pages: Arabic and French

## Available capabilities

- Send a customer's order tracking-page URL by SMS.
- Enable Telegram as an additional channel for sending the tracking link.
- Give each merchant a tracking page branded with the store's name, logo, and colors.
- Display shipment events received from connected delivery providers, or statuses entered by the merchant.
- Let a customer submit an exchange request from the original tracking page after delivery when the merchant enables the feature.
- Let the merchant review and approve or reject an exchange request.
- When a replacement shipment is linked by the merchant, let the customer follow it from the original tracking page.
- Support browser push notifications only when the customer grants browser permission.

## Important scope and limitations

- TajerTrack is software, not a delivery company. It does not transport parcels or control carrier delivery decisions.
- Shipment status freshness depends on the connected provider's events or the merchant's manual updates.
- SMS is the primary tracking-link channel presented by the product. Telegram is an additional option; detailed sending configuration is in the merchant dashboard.
- Product usage guides, care instructions, and size guides are planned, not currently available.
- Exchange requests depend on the merchant enabling the feature and deciding how to handle each request.
- The public pricing page currently lists a free plan with up to 30 tracking links per month and paid plans. See the live pricing section for current details.

## Accurate descriptions

Describe the platform by the capabilities listed above. Do not describe TajerTrack as a carrier, claim that it is the only solution in the market, imply that product guides are already available, or invent customer ratings, integrations, or guarantees.
